_comment: References the workspace's A/B + copy-fidelity gates compare against. tools/fetch-snapshots.mjs materializes these into .cache/snapshots/ (gitignored). A ref with a `bundle` field materializes from a committed local git bundle (durable, reproducible on clone); a ref with only `repo`+`sha` clones the remote at that SHA. The frozen sibling checkouts under /Users/jhp/code/jackhp95 remain read-only and are no longer the reference for these two.
_comment_elm_cem: elm-cem's generator forked AHEAD of upstream main (ad5d523) at the R-025 emitter change (D-045/D-046): M3e.Build.<X> now routes phantom types through the exposed M3e.Component.<X> surface. That change is workspace-only and un-upstreamed, so Face A (ab-elm-cem) can no longer compare against a remote SHA. The reference is now a committed git bundle of the workspace generator itself (post-change); Face A thus catches FUTURE accidental generator drift and forces a conscious re-baseline (re-bundle + bump sha) on any intended generator change. See D-046.
